## bijection_verdict

**PASS** — the three extended policies (baseline + every tier of every factor), the two prerequisites, the retired surface and the governing base policies correspond at the level of entailment. First revision.

Policy-side note (does not change this verdict): the rate-cut factor's "adjusted in the last twelve calendar months" does not name which date of the adjustment record counts; the source rule text has the same wording and its compute pins `received_date`. The KB carries the source at its own strength.

- Titles/openings general ("Compromise Offers Signed by the Debtor", "Reduced Monthly Withholding from VA Benefit Payments", "Reduced-Withholding Requests"); none mirrors this task.
- Baseline documents carry no modification hints; factor documents state ladders as rules and never assign a customer to a tier.
- Findability: hops reachable via "approved reduced monthly withholding … benefit payments" and "reduced-withholding request"; factors reachable from record words (Housebound category, net worth, countable income, pension offset rows, denied waiver decision, fsr_submitted, `pension_rate_adjusted` with `overpayment_created`, notice date).
